## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: docs/guides/documentation.md contains a table with exactly five actions,...

The system SHALL ensure that docs/guides/documentation.md contains a table with exactly five actions, each row naming its evidence floor (2 distinct sessions with quotes; 2 sessions with harm for remove; exempt for extract and move) and its mechanical check.

#### Scenario: docs/guides/documentation.md contains a table with exactly five actions,...

WHEN `define-memory-actions-and-placement-policy` is implemented
THEN docs/guides/documentation.md contains a table with exactly five actions, each row naming its evidence floor (2 distinct sessions with quotes; 2 sessions with harm for remove; exempt for extract and move) and its mechanical check.

WHEN `define-memory-actions-and-placement-policy` is implemented
THEN The same guide contains a placement section mapping broad (20 percent of sessions or safety) to AGENTS.md, narrow-with-trigger to a skill, and narrow-without-trigger to deletion, and states the corroboration unit chosen for this corpus (distinct changes or distinct interactive sessions).

WHEN `define-memory-actions-and-placement-policy` is implemented
THEN openspec/specs/skill-workflow/spec.md references the memory-actions section by path and no longer carries its own contradictory keep/cut wording.

The system SHALL ensure that the extract action text states that every removed line must reappear in the created or extended SKILL.md and that the description delta is charged to the always-loaded budget.
